newsitem.title: INDIA: India firm plans 650,000T manganese ore in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: India firm plans 650,000T manganese ore in 97/98.

text.p: India's state-run Manganese Ore (India) Ltd (MOIL) plans to produce 650,000 tonnes of manganese ore in 1997/98 (April-March), up from an estimated 640,000 in 1996/97, the Steel Ministry said on Tuesday.
A ministry statement said the company also hopes to increase output of electrolytic manganese dioxide, a value added product, to 750 tonnes in 1997/98 from 600 in 1996/97.
The statement said MOIL signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on Tuesday with the Steel Ministry on its 1997/98 output targets.
MOIL is India's largest producer of high grade manganese ore and accounts for more than 70 percent of supplies to the domestic ferro-manganese industry.
It also supplies blast furnace grade managanese ore to the iron and steel sector.
